observations.prompt: How do I check text contrast?
observations.answerText: Aviary checks contrast against the selected background.

observations.prompt: How do I check text contrast?
observations.answerText: Measure the text and background with a contrast checker.

observations.prompt: How can I review keyboard access?
observations.answerText: Aviary includes checks for keyboard interaction and focus order.

observations.prompt: How can I review keyboard access?
observations.answerText: Check that every control is reachable and usable from the keyboard.
Aviary reviews structure, labels, contrast, and keyboard behavior.
Accessible pages support varied ways of perceiving and operating content.

observations.prompt: How do I test a screen reader flow?
observations.answerText: Aviary can help identify structural issues before assistive-technology review.

observations.prompt: How do I test a screen reader flow?
observations.answerText: Test headings, labels, focus movement, and announcements with a screen reader.
